status: Development baseline for diagnostic Sim2Sim; stopping limitations unresolved; not hardware-qualified
extraction: Frozen and truth rows only, copied from the existing three-way screen. No new closed-loop panel. Original files unchanged.
provenance_warning: The original top-level checkpoint is the fine-tuned candidate. Frozen rows are bound individually by checkpoint and tensor hashes; only *_frozen comparisons apply here.

definitions.stop_definitions: component RMS = sqrt(mean(v_xy**2)); planar-speed RMS = sqrt(mean(vx**2+vy**2)); final windows are last 1 s
definitions.settling: planar <=.02 m/s and abs(body yaw rate)<=.03 rad/s continuously to window end for >=.25 s; diagnostic only
definitions.noise_assumptions: Synthetic uniform sensor noise, not measured IMU statistics. No extra sensor bias. Nominal physics in both conditions.
